[1mDescription[22m:
Manage the PICO Emulator lifecycle, setup, and diagnostics

[1mUsage[22m:
  $ [1mpico-cli emulator[22m <command> [options]

[1mCommands[22m:
  [1mcreate[22m                   Create a PICO emulator AVD without starting it
  [1mdelete[22m                   Delete CLI-created PICO emulator AVDs from the local host
  [1mdelete-image[22m             Delete downloaded PICO emulator bundles and download cache from the host
  [1mdoctor[22m                   Check required enviro
